title: Akridge Scout Reservation

services.name: Summer Camping
services.desc: Del-Mar-Va Council holds multiple day camps every summer in locations across the Delmarva peninsula. Day camps are five-day programs for boys and girls in 1st-5th grade, including youth who are not currently Cub Scouts. They are conducted under certified leadership at approved sites and during daylight or early evening hours. Day camp does not include any overnight activities. Certification of our day camp directors and program directors is provided through the National Camping School. Day camp programs are theme-based and usually include nature, sports, aquatics, and crafts. Den and pack leaders often make up the nucleus of each day camp staff. Day Camp is fun and adventure with a purpose!

services.name: “On Belay”
services.desc: Try out the Climbing Tower to test your strength and balance, all while 30 feet in the air. Our trained staff will demonstrate all the proper techniques. Showcasing knots, commands and climbing skills. Once you’ve mastered the climb, try rappelling

blurb: Akridge Scout Reservation is located on 85 acres of the former Kesselring family farm. The camp features 9 campsites as well as 3 pavilions, an outdoor arena, and a covered 32-position archery range. The Scout camp is bordered by two county parks, an elementary school, and many suburban neighborhoods.
